notes.title: Scrappage
notes.content:
Unfortunately the release of Scrappage was more early access than a complete game: Many features were missing and it really was a buggy mess.

Though there are still a few bugs here and there, Scrappage is now more stable than ever. And the list of features added since launch grows longer and longer:

[list]
[*] new final epic boss fight
[*] full local coop support
[*] new start characters
[*] improved UI, more feedback
[*] new maps, skills, enemies, defenses, weapons, items, body parts, music and more
[*] great balancing improvements
[*] quadrillions of bugs fixes
[/list]

If you haven't played Scrappage for a while, please give it a another try. 

Thank you guys so much for your patience and support! ❤

notes.title: Final Fight
notes.content:
Hellow fellow Scrappers!

Yet another big patch! This time I focused on the final boss: The chaotic rumble against four bosses is replaced by an epic fight against a huge monster, followed by the usual fight against the last boss. Besides that, I introduced a few new stats, items, body parts and new ways to deal damage to support HP, Ammo and Knockdown builds. Going through the code, I found and fixed a lot of old bugs. Together with an engine update, the game should run more stable than ever before.

[h3]New stuff[/h3]

[list]
[*] new final boss fight,
[*] extra damage refactoring:
  - Collision Damage: extra damage from knockback collisions,
  - Rage Damage: extra damage by missing health,
  - Iced Damage: extra damage against frozen targets,
  - Toxicated Damage: extra damage against poisoned targets,
  - Quick Ammo: extra attack speed based on ammo left in magazine,
[*] added new body parts,
[*] new items increasing your maximum resistance (resistance over 100% will heal instead of damaging),
[*] new item compressor charger: increased attack speed depending on ammunition left,
[*] new item razor blades: increases maximum critical chance,
[*] new item Laser Extension: automatically fires an energy shot at nearby enemies,
[*] new item Frost Chamber: automatically freezes a nearby enemy,
[/list]

[h3]Improvements / changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] improved body part visuals and variety,
[*] players and bosses shoot slower while being frozen,
[*] added pickup hints to tutorial,
[*] rage damage now deals absolute damage per missing health,
[*] other players now can select an item from chests too,
[*] recycling does not abort other players selection,
[*] color coding for coop players,
[*] separated aim and hardcore mode: toggle hardcore difficulty for auto aiming or normal mode,
[*] clamped max critical chance (limit can be increased with items or body parts),
[*] increased chance for weapons in the shop,
[*] improved enemy stats highlights,
[*] added play time tracking,
[*] prevent duplicates in chest item selection,
[*] shader performance improvements,
[*] improved map validation,
[*] maximum resistance: resistance over 100% will now heal instead of taking damage,
[*] perk descriptions,
[*] show player stats in level selection,
[*] rotate enemies in level selection,
[*] bosses (and their loot) have a chance for upgraded equipment and items,
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] fixed multiple 2nd player controller issues,
[*] fixed ability power not being applied to projectiles,
[*] fixed actions not being applied to the correct targets,
[*] fixed life steal calculation,
[*] fixed FX texture bleeding,
[*] fixed normals of several floor textures,
[*] fixed weapon upgrade, weak point and critical damage calculation,
[*] fixed summons of summons life time,
[*] fixed damage modifiers not shown correctly in the UI,
[*] fixed input tutorial no closing correctly,
[*] fixed controller not working when activated in the menu,
[*] fixed tons of other issues and bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for December 26th
notes.content:
With this update, you can adjust the power of the screen tint effects in the settings menu. The base power of the damage screen tint effect is now relative to the damage taken, so there is no anoying flashing anymore when taking little poison damage.

The last perk (Damage Booster) is really weak compared to the other perks and was only meant (and requested) as an extra when all the other perks are unlocked already. But somehow, almost every new player unlocks them first. Not anymore! With this update, the damage booster perk are now hidden until all the others perks are unlocked.


New

[list]
[*]screen tint settings
[/list]

Adjustments

[list]
[*]damage feedback screen tint based on relative damage (reduces flickering)
[*]reset and hide damage booster perk until max level
[*]prevent bosses using strong actions in the first few levels
[*]increased random summon duration
[*]regeneration relative to max health
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*]Turkish localization fixes
[*]fixed arrows not hitting damage marker
[*]fixed summon sliding
[*]fixed drone weapon stats now showing
[*]tutorial spelling fixes
[*]fixed missing shop bug
[/list]
